metadata.title: Advanced Governance Suite Tasks
metadata.description: Consolidate all node management and governance tasks into a single interface to reduce operational errors and eliminate CLI dependency.

phases.name: Foundation & Koios Integration
phases.description: Establish Koios API integration and data models for governance actions.

tasks.title: Implement Koios API client
tasks.description: Create backend service to fetch governance actions via Koios API.

tasks.title: Database schema for governance
tasks.description: Create Liquibase migrations and JPA entities for storing and caching governance actions and voting history.

phases.name: Chain Scanner & Metadata
phases.description: Implement scanning logic and metadata resolution.

tasks.title: Chain Scanner Implementation
tasks.description: Implement background job to identify new on-chain governance actions and map to SPO/DRep roles.

tasks.title: Metadata Resolution
tasks.description: Lookup and resolve JSON-LD metadata, with error handling and sanitization.

tasks.title: Adastat.net Fallback Linking
tasks.description: Ensure every governance action provides a persistent link to adastat.net.

phases.name: Voting & Security
phases.description: Multi-identity voting, cold key signing, and vote lifecycle.

tasks.title: Multi-Identity Voting Modal
tasks.description: Update UI to support selecting multiple pools/DReps for batched voting.

tasks.title: Secure Signing & Transactions
tasks.description: Integrate encrypted cold-key pattern for transaction building and sign/submit flow, ensuring keys are wiped from memory.

tasks.title: Change Vote Workflow
tasks.description: Allow users to initiate a change vote workflow for active proposals.

phases.name: Certificates & Dashboard UI
phases.description: Registration workflows, UI integration, and history features.

tasks.title: DRep/SPO Registration Certificates
tasks.description: Guided workflows for DRep/SPO registration, update, retirement with deposit source wallet selection.

tasks.title: Governance Dashboard
tasks.description: Create the main governance UI with active actions, real-time states, and history tab.

tasks.title: History & Expiration Logic
tasks.description: Automatically move expired actions to History tab and mark them as Completed after voting.

riskAreas: Memory wiping of decrypted cold keys
summary.testingNotes: Unit tests for metadata resolution and transaction building. E2E tests for the voting flow.
